notes.title: Farm-Bred and Campground-Ready: The Workmen’s Story
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267538/a50a82a4beab05ce2bdfc53e1e29e68cda975536.png[/img]
The Workman family has been Addie’s loyal helpers since the very beginning. Without their help, there’s no way she could have made it to where she is today.

👖ːsteammockingː Identical Jeans, Shared Dreams?
It’s not every day you see a whole family with identical jeans — perhaps they shop at the same retailer? Or maybe their uniformity has deeper roots: a quirky genetic twist? A secretive leader's peculiar fashion mandate? Or just a shared love for mustaches and breezy scalps? Who’s to say? 🕵️‍♂️

🎙️ Masters of Mysterious Communication
The Workman cousins have a unique talent: they speak in an indecipherable shorthand that only they can understand. This makes them lightning-fast when working together but leaves everyone else scratching their heads in confusion. 🤷‍♂️

🌾 Farm-Bred Strength and Skills
Legend has it that the Workmen honed their skills on a farm, where they began mastering their craft at a young age. By the time they were six, they could fell trees in a single blow (or so the stories go). 🌳💪

🏕️ Finding Their Calling
As adults, the cousins ventured into town and found their perfect match — a sign advertising work setting up campgrounds. It was a match made in heaven! Since then, they’ve been a cornerstone of Addie’s success. Together, they’ve built, maintained, and expanded her operations, proving their unwavering dedication.

So next time you see a campground set up flawlessly or a tree cleared with precision, give a little nod to the Workmen. They’ve earned it!

notes.title: Meet the Inventor! ⚙️💥
notes.notes:
[b]Inventor 🛠️[/b]  

Eccentric? Mad? Genius? Perhaps a bit of all three. Ever wondered if there’s a way to butter toast while it’s toasting? Chances are, he has, and gone through at least seven different prototypes along the way. 🍞✨  

There’s no task he cannot automate and no gadget he can’t create… well, if there is, he hasn't found it yet! 🔧⚙️ He’s happiest when he’s got tools in his hand, and a faint aroma of his own singed eyebrows in his nose. 😅🔥  

While he doesn’t long for the great outdoors like his other companions, he does seem to keep finding himself on rugged inventions in the pursuit of his creations. 🌲🔨  

His inventions don’t always go the way he expects, plans, or even hopes. But therein lies the soul of invention; mistakes often lead to even bigger mistakes, which present a whole new set of problems. And where there’s a problem, there’s a solution! 💡💥  

Not one to trust technology he hasn’t built with his own two hands, he shies away from things like cell phones 📱 and computers 💻. Cogs and gears are more his style, microchips are boring. As he always says: “If it ticks, it does the trick!” ⏰  

He can get a bit messy when he’s in the zone, but he has quite the knack for remembering where he puts everything. 🗂️ But when he doesn’t, he’s got his loyal companion, [b]Parrot[/b] 🦜, to help him out. (More on him later!)

notes.title: Meet Addie: The Trailblazing Heart of Campgrounds Adventures
notes.notes:
[b]Addie is our original Campgrounds veteran[/b]. 🏕️ She’s been stakin’ tents and pitchin’ tarp since the very beginning, and if there’s one thing she knows, it’s how to set up[b] camp[/b]! 🛠️ She’s as hardworking as they come, and once she sets her sights on a task, she doesn’t quit until the job is done. 💪 Level-headed and responsible, there's no one you’d rather have on your side in a crisis. 🚨

A true nature lover at heart, Addie is happiest when she’s out on trail 🥾 or getting lost in the beauty of nature. 🌲 Not one to shy away from dirt and mud, she’s always willing to help out a friend 🫂 or someone in need. In fact, this is more often than not what leads her to getting into all sorts of shenanigans. 🤭

Addie can find it difficult to assert her opinion amongst friends, but stick her in a room with the boss 👩‍💼 or anyone who goes against what she stands for, and she won’t hesitate to give them a piece of her mind. 💬 Whether you call it strong will or sheer stubbornness, Addie won’t stand for injustice ✊ nor budge for corruption. If she thinks someone is practicing harmful campground construction, you can be sure she’ll do everything in her power to do what’s right for the environment. 🌿💚
